newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-PERU REACH COPA AMERICA QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PERU REACH COPA AMERICA QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: Peru, fielding a team that is basically an under-23 side with a couple of regular internationals thrown in, beat Venezuela 2-0 Wednesday to reach the quarter-finals of the Copa America.

Striker Paul Cominges scored both goals as Peru finished on six points in group B, guaranteeing them a place in the last eight regardless of the outcome of the Bolivia-Venezuela game being played later.

Venezuela, who lost all their games, were the only team who failed to score a goal in the tournament but may be happy with a defensive record of five goals against, having let in 13 goals in 1993 and ten in 1995.

Peru had an early let-off when Gabriel Urbaneta blasted a powerful long-range drive against the crossbar and shortly afterwards Cominges fired them in front when he broke clear of the defence and fired the ball past goalkeeper Rafael Dudamel.
Cominges wrapped the game up with a scrambled goal in the 59th minutes, shortly after Jose Rey had become the third Venezuelan player in three games to receive a red card.
Peru, like many teams, have rested their top players for the World Cup qualifiers and are using the competition to experiment with younger ones.
